title: SNODAS modeled snow depth and SWE, Colorado
timeNote: validFrom/validTo is the 06:00 UTC snapshot. publishedAt is the NSIDC HTTP Last-Modified of the archive. The source header creation time has no stated time zone and is kept as text.

legend.label: No data, or saturated value flagged by NSIDC

grid.format: int16 little-endian, 2 interleaved bands per cell, row-major from the NW corner

units.snow_depth_mm: millimetres of snow depth (divide by 10 for cm)

crs.image: EPSG:3857 pixel grid, corners given in EPSG:4326 for a MapLibre image source

sources.name: NOHRSC Snow Data Assimilation System (SNODAS) Data Products at NSIDC, Version 1 (G02158), masked

snow_depth.description: Modeled snow layer thickness, total of snow layers

swe.description: Modeled snow water equivalent, total of snow layers

sources.terms: NSIDC: 'As a condition of using these data, you must cite the use of this data set.' No other license text is given on the landing page.
sources.citation: National Operational Hydrologic Remote Sensing Center. 2004. Snow Data Assimilation System (SNODAS) Data Products at NSIDC, Version 1. Colorado subset. Boulder, Colorado USA. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. https://doi.org/10.7265/N5TB14TC. Date accessed 2026-11-06.

limitations: Modeled analysis, not a measurement: NOHRSC snow model with data assimilation, one value per 30 arc-second cell (about 0.7 km east-west by 0.9 km north-south in Colorado). It cannot resolve wind loading, cornices, gullies, aspect-scale differences or conditions on a ski line. Do not read ski-line-scale detail into the image.
Snapshot of the snowpack state at 06:00 UTC on the analysis date (11 PM MST the previous evening, or midnight MDT). It does not change during the day.
Snow depth and SWE are the whole snowpack. They are not new snow, snowfall or forecast snowfall.

NSIDC documents erroneously high SWE in some high-elevation regions; values at the int16 ceiling (32767) are flagged as saturated and drawn as no data. Zero is a valid modeled value (no snow) and is distinct from no data.
NSIDC lists G02158 at a 'Basic' level of service; days can be late or missing (see https://noaadata.apps.nsidc.org/NOAA/G02158/G02158_missing_files.txt).
The PNG is resampled (nearest neighbour) to Web Mercator for display only; read values from the numeric grid.
Not an avalanche, stability or travel product. Says nothing about avalanche danger.
processingNote: Built offline from the tar downloaded at retrievedAt (snodas.py --tar); publishedAt is that download's HTTP Last-Modified.
